messages:
Maria (CS): kicking off onboarding for Lunera — hi all, looping in @Tyler, @Ashok, @Jordan. primary goals: (1) basic prod traffic on Redwood Hosted, (2) baseline latency < 200ms p95 for core endpoints, (3) enablement for their support team. thoughts? :wave:
Tyler - PM: thanks Maria. high-level success criteria: 1) integration smoke tests green, 2) 2-week pilot with key workflows, 3) adoption metrics dashboard set in Console. propose 6-week timeline. :calendar:
Ashok (SE): noted. will need their infra contacts and API key rotation plan. potential VPC peering for private routing? also flaging model size constraints if they want low-latency small-model variant.
Jordan (SE): I can own runbooks + playbook for failover. suggest a canary on week 3 and capacity check in week 4. I'll add rollback criteria.
Maria (CS): thanks — immediate blockers: Lunera legal needs to confirm data retention settings and KMS approach. @Tyler can you help get contract/inc security contact?
Tyler - PM: on it. I'll ping legal and cc @Maria. also asked Lunera for initial datasets and 2 sample prompts by EOD Fri.
OnboardBot: Project created — "Lunera Onboarding". Milestones: kickoff, integration, canary, pilot, wrap. Owner: Maria (CS).
Ashok (SE): quick checklist for infra access (share with Lunera):
```
- API key (test)
- VPC CIDR for peering (if private)
- Service account for metrics ingestion (read-only)
- Allowed IPs for egress
```
Jordan (SE): I'll schedule a 60m enablement demo for engineers + support. options: Tue 10am or Thu 3pm PT. which works? :thinking_face:
Maria (CS): Tue 10am PT works for Lunera. I'll send invite and attach runbook draft. :thumbsup:
Tyler - PM: renewal risk note — their contract is up in 11 months. early signals: they care about latency and cost. we should capture cost/latency tradeoffs in the pilot and call out quantization/instance plans in week 2.
Maria (CS): agreed — capture in success criteria doc. also plan an Ops Q/A (support enablement) week after pilot start.
Ashok (SE): heads-up: if they do dedicated GPUs later, we should prepare a migration checklist. adding a short doc to the repo and will link in the kickoff invite.
Jordan (SE): feedback capture: recommend short NPS at week 2 and open feedback doc for engineers (editable). I'll create a simple Google form + an internal tracking sheet.
Maria (CS): action items recap: Tyler — legal contact & sample prompts; Ashok — infra checklist + migration note; Jordan — runbook + demo + feedback form; Maria — invite, success criteria doc, pilot dashboard. I'll follow up with a status update on Friday. :clipboard:
Tyler - PM: thanks. any additional risks? e.g., custom model ops, or data residency?
Maria (CS): data residency is likely (EU infra). flagged. Ashok, can we confirm region parity by week 1?
Ashok (SE): can do. I'll validate available regions and post findings here by Wed.
Maria (CS): perfect. closing thread for now — will post invite and docs. ping here for urgent items. :rocket:
